confirmed_entry_filters.age_notes: Sweet spot 2-20h. ZEN still active at 72h. REVISED (2026-04-04): GAJAE (1515h, 63 days) and Hamster (613h, 25 days) show old tokens can re-awaken with monster buy ratios. Rule revised: after 48h require h24 > 40% + buy ratio in zone. After 168h require h24 > 80% + buy ratio in zone. FML=418h with h24=+47% was dead (vol/liq=0.2x), not a revival.
confirmed_entry_filters.score_at_entry: 3-10 — DO NOT gate on score alone. PISS=3 (22x), NoHat=4 (18x), LOLA=4 (15x). Average monster score = 5.6. MIN_SCORE=8 would reject 4 of 5 Raydium monsters.

Having Twitter/Telegram linked is NEUTRAL — it is normal token metadata. What matters is: NO ACTIVE INFLUENCER CALLS AT ENTRY. Socials exist = normal. Active Twitter promotion = token already priced in. The real signal is buy ratio, not social presence.

mc_at_entry_estimate.notes: At graduation tokens open ~$15k-$60k MC. By the time our bot spots them at 2-20h old they may already be $50k-$300k MC. Still massively undervalued vs peak ($1M-$10M+).

exit_strategy.trailing_stop_verdict: ONLY exit that captures monsters. Fixed TP at ANY level kills the trade.
exit_strategy.fixed_tp_verdict: KILLS THE TRADE — ZEN=143x, BURNIE=+2214%, milkers=+1380% would all exit at 30-60% TP missing 95-99% of the move

buy_ratio_exception_large_liq.rule: For tokens with liq > $200k AND age > 180 days: buy ratio floor is 46% (not 50%). Standard 50% floor applies to all tokens with liq < $200k.
buy_ratio_exception_large_liq.examples: boden=49.2% ($310k liq, 762 days) — MONSTER. pippin=48.7% ($5M liq, 511 days) — MONSTER. Both below 50% but massive established communities.
buy_ratio_exception_large_liq.why: At very high liq+age, profit-taker sell volume naturally dilutes the buy ratio even during active accumulation. The absolute buy size is large even at 48-49%. Standard 50% floor is correct for all new/small tokens.

narrative_taxonomy.insight: Political memes and AI narrative tokens have the LONGEST runway — they spike repeatedly on news events. Humor/universal memes spike fastest and hardest but are one-wave. Emotional/loyalty memes sustain buying for months. Gaming/retro attract specific demographics with sustained buying.

kol_creator_signal.confirmed_case: pippin — created by yoheinakajima (BabyAGI creator, 1.8M Twitter followers). Real KOL with ongoing influence. Each new AI release/tweet drives a fresh wave. $42M MC, $5M liq, $16M daily volume.
kol_creator_signal.rule: If pump.fun description or token socials link to a real KOL with >100k Twitter followers who is ACTIVE in the space — this is a STRONG positive signal. The KOL is the recurring wave catalyst.
kol_creator_signal.detection: Check pump.fun description text for X/Twitter profile links or known names. GSD description: 'Deployed using j7tracker.com' (bundler, not KOL). Pippin description: links directly to yoheinakajima tweet.

j7tracker_bundler_signal.what_it_means: j7tracker.com is a Solana token bundler tool used for coordinated launches — the team pre-loads wallets to hit graduation fast. Fast graduation + j7tracker description = organized team, not a random rug. Combined with X community link = organized long-term project.
j7tracker_bundler_signal.rule: j7tracker in description = POSITIVE signal (organized team, not a one-shot rug). NOT negative. Different from high top1-holder concentration which IS negative.

x_community_signal.confirmed_case: GSD — website field is x.com/i/communities/2012289562848956790 (X community link)
x_community_signal.what_it_means: An X Community is a persistent organized buying group with ongoing coordination. Much stronger than a regular Twitter account — these are self-selected committed buyers. If token's website/socials links to X Community, expect organized repeated buying waves.
x_community_signal.confirmed_live_proof: Pluto the Penguin 2026-04-05 — X community link present, token went +297% h24

top1_holder_analysis.normal_range: 5-22% for graduated tokens (bonding curve pool shows as ~20-21%)
top1_holder_analysis.danger_threshold: >50% = instant rug risk (hardcoded block in check_token_safety)
top1_holder_analysis.insight: LOL at 2.12% and HACHI at 3.88% are exceptionally distributed — no whale can exit and kill the price. This is why they sustain. When top1 < 10%, the token is structurally more resilient to dumps.

killer_disqualifiers: buy_ratio < 50% AND liq < $200k — sellers in control (ROCKET 37.8%, Quality 44.7%) — HARD BLOCK
buy_ratio < 46% even for large liq tokens — too seller-dominated — HARD BLOCK
buy_ratio > 65% — euphoric top buyers, late-stage pump (FML 69.9%, apple 79.8%) — HARD BLOCK
vol_liq > 5x — pump/dump or wash trading in progress (Quality 34.9x) — HARD BLOCK
vol_liq < 0.5x — dead volume, nobody cares (FML 0.2x, apple 0.1x, BULL 0.3x) — HARD BLOCK
liq < $20k — micro-cap rug zone — HARD BLOCK
age > 48h AND h24 < 40% AND liq < $100k — already ran and dead (BULL: 266h, +1% h24) — SKIP
age > 168h AND h24 < 80% AND liq < $150k — very old, no revival momentum — SKIP
m5 < -20% — already dumping hard at entry (Quality -27.5%) — HARD BLOCK
score < 3 — below any reasonable floor — HARD BLOCK (but score 3-4 is FINE for monsters)
top1_holder > 50% — whale concentration, instant rug (hardcoded block) — HARD BLOCK
ACTIVE influencer promotion at entry — token already priced in — CAUTION (having socials is NEUTRAL)
vol_liq_critical_note: Vol/liq at CHECK TIME is always high (10-40x) because the monster has already pumped. The filter must be applied at ENTRY TIME when vol/liq is 1-3x. ELUN checked at 35.8x, Dunald at 40.2x, SpaceX at 25.4x — all were ~2-4x at their entry window (1-4h old).
political_meme_pattern: ELUN, Dunald, SpaceX, boden — 4 of 17 true/revival monsters are political memes. These have multi-wave structure: US wave 1, European/Asian secondary wave 12-24h later. boden at 762 days proves political memes NEVER truly die — they revive on every news cycle. Liberation Day tariff announcement April 2 triggered ALL political memes simultaneously.
raydium_speed_note: SpaceX did +11683% in 4.4 HOURS on Raydium — fastest in dataset. Raydium native launches can peak much faster than PumpSwap graduates. Raydium scanner MUST be catching tokens at 1-2h old.
meteora_confirmed: BIGLY and GSD confirm Meteora as monster-capable. Both 50-90 days old with sustained buy ratios 57-59%. Strategy D is validated.
revival_pattern: GAJAE (63d), Hamster (25d), boden (762d), black (201d), HACHI (128d) — 5 confirmed revival cases. Common thread: buy ratio RETURNS to 50-65% zone after dormancy. The re-entry of buy pressure into the monster zone is the signal, not the age.
our_bot_missed_elun: Paper bot entered ELUN at 2.3h old and Haiku exited at 4 minutes with +24%. Token went on to +1152%. This is the exact Haiku-too-early mistake that prompted the 30-min minimum hold fix.
liberation_day_cluster: 8 of 15+ dated monsters graduated or spiked within 72h of April 2 2026 Trump tariff announcement. Political + macro uncertainty = meme season. When major political/economic news hits, ALL narrative tokens spike together. Flag: when >3 political memes spike same day, enter monster-detection overdrive.
